directives.intuition: The 30Y yield at 5.31% while Fed signals pause and equities hold suggests bond market pricing a risk consensus ignores—fiscal crisis or term premium regime shift; watch credit spreads for the trigger
directives.summary: Hormuz ship attack 4min ago confirms Iran escalation risk; oil $88-91 holding, BoJ signals Sept hike (10Y at 30Y high), RBA hawkish; caution mode, favor JPY/gold/AUD/oil
